motion.name: blade-in
motion.purpose: Single authored entrance: yellow blade clips in from the left.

components.name: Boarding button
components.description: Primary hire action. Ink plate, yellow type, wayfinding arrow.
components.css: .ds-boarding { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #0e1114; color: #ffcc00; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; } .ds-boarding:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-boarding:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e1114; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #ffcc00; }

components.name: Active destination plate
components.css: .ds-plate-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffcc00; color: #0e1114; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; }

narrative.overview: The hiring site is a terminal: enamel plates, a proof timetable, and an ID portrait. Yellow is committed at region scale. Corners are square.
dos: Do put proof in a timetable or a plate.
Do let a flagship own a unique hall object.
donts: Don't use Inter or gradient text.
Don't wrap sections in rounded cards.
Don't add kickers or numbered eyebrows.
